constraints.name: check_time_period_code_format
constraints.expression: (time_period_code LIKE 'Q_' AND time_period_code IN ('Q1', 'Q2', 'Q3', 'Q4')) OR (time_period_code LIKE 'M__' AND time_period_code >= 'M01' AND time_period_code <= 'M12')

constraints.name: ck_ball_traj_coords_state
constraints.expression: (tracking_state = 'lost' AND ball_x IS NULL AND ball_y IS NULL) OR (tracking_state != 'lost' AND ball_x IS NOT NULL AND ball_y IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_juggling_contact_model_confidence_range
constraints.expression: model_confidence IS NULL OR (model_confidence >= 0.0 AND model_confidence <= 1.0)

constraints.name: ck_vt_forfeit_reason_valid
constraints.expression: forfeit_reason IS NULL OR forfeit_reason IN ('deadline_expired', 'no_contest', 'no_show', 'post_start_timeout')

constraints.name: ck_cc_result
constraints.expression: result IS NULL OR result IN ('success','partial','failed')

constraints.name: ck_juggling_ball_detections_confidence
constraints.expression: confidence IS NULL OR (confidence >= 0.0 AND confidence <= 1.0)

constraints.name: ck_juggling_ball_detections_coords
constraints.expression: (no_ball_detected = true AND ball_x IS NULL AND ball_y IS NULL) OR (no_ball_detected = false AND ball_x IS NOT NULL AND ball_y IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_ball_feedback_corrected_coords
constraints.expression: decision != 'corrected' OR (corrected_x IS NOT NULL AND corrected_y IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: ck_juggling_pose_snapshots_inference_confidence
constraints.expression: inference_confidence IS NULL OR (inference_confidence >= 0.0 AND inference_confidence <= 1.0)

constraints.name: ck_cs_capture_result
constraints.expression: capture_result IS NULL OR capture_result IN ('success','error','interrupted')

constraints.name: check_one_credit_reference
constraints.expression: (user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_license_id IS NULL) OR (user_id IS NULL AND user_license_id IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: instructor_rating_range
constraints.expression: instructor_rating IS NULL OR (instructor_rating >= 1.0 AND instructor_rating <= 5.0)

constraints.name: session_quality_range
constraints.expression: session_quality IS NULL OR (session_quality >= 1.0 AND session_quality <= 5.0)
